title: Characters
desc: Define project characters and assign each a voice and color.
lede: Characters let dialogue sound distinct. Define them once, give each a voice and color, and assignment does the rest.
body:
At a glance
  • Create a character.
  • Assign a voice profile/variant.
  • Use color coding to scan who speaks.

Create a character

Add the characters that appear in your book. The narrator exists by default; characters cover everyone else.

Assign a voice

Give each character a voice (and variant). Their assigned lines render in that voice. See Characters & Narrators.

Color coding

Each character gets a color so you can scan a chapter and see who speaks which lines at a glance.

Coming with 2.0 — AI voice casting can suggest a fitting voice per character from your library, with a reason — you confirm the picks.
